title: Surface persistent Engram background revocation retry failures
outcome: A failed retry of an older unconfirmed authority revocation must not fail an unrelated settings edit, but stderr-only reporting makes persistent failure invisible to the operator. Add a durable, redacted diagnostic surface (for example last error/count on the retired-authority ledger or a bounded project/session notice) without restoring request failure or exposing grant hashes.
